chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him)
In it, he admonishes and expounds the excellences of the Qur'an and forbids innovation
ai.seo_question: What are the main themes of Imam Ali's sermon regarding the Qur'an and innovation?
ai.summary: In this sermon from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) elevates the Qur'an as the ultimate criterion for distinguishing truth from falsehood, framing its mastery as essential for spiritual integrity. He simultaneously warns against *bid'ah* (religious innovation), linking it to the deviation of the Khawarij and other sects, thereby establishing the Sunnah as the living interpretation of the Qur'anic text. This dual focus underscores the Shia emphasis on adhering to the Prophet's authentic tradition to preserve the purity of Islamic doctrine.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Admonishing the people, expounding the excellences of the Qur’ān and forbidding innovation
